subject: @abh/core MissionSummary projection source vector, authorized retrieval and monotonic recovery
coverage: read.projections now stores purpose names, a source version vector and built time through an Expand migration
projection retrieval binds exact projection type and rejects another purpose or workspace
MissionSummary rebuild locks the source mission and recomputes trigger and blocker counts
identical source vectors replay the stored projection without advancing its database version
changed source vectors atomically update the projection and advance its version
an older source vector cannot regress a higher mission version, goal revision, stop epoch or counts
a native pg-boss delivery is observed with bounded eventual visibility rather than an immediate race
limits: only MissionSummary is implemented; ResponsibilityInbox, ActionTimeline, OrganizationSettings and CapabilityOverview remain
refresh is source-backed and synchronous; the event-driven Outbox projection consumer, RefreshProjection job and SSE reset path remain
projection list pagination, field-set redaction, subscription cursors and consumer gap recovery remain
